description: Bruegel's EU renewables value tracker describes the economic performance of solar photovoltaic, onshore wind and offshore wind generation across European electricity markets. Published in March 2026 with data through 2025, it reports annual capacity factors, generation-weighted market values and annual revenue per unit of installed capacity. Its methodology harmonises ENTSO-E price and generation inputs recorded at 15, 30 or 60 minute intervals and combines them with installed capacity. Solar capacity uses EMBER except for Norway; specified national sources fill gaps, and country-specific corrections are documented. Coverage is European bidding zones and annual country comparisons. The public web presentation is free; a dataset-specific reuse licence and downloadable file format were not established. Caveats include inconsistent reporting thresholds and capacity definitions, indicative estimates, and the use of end-of-year capacities for subsequent-year calculations. These infrastructure performance and revenue indicators support capacity-planning and generation-placement studies. The related ENTSO-E records describe underlying system observations, which differ from this derived tracker. Chart data and linked files were not retrieved.
